Citations come from [`references.bib`](https://github.com/ajm-glitch/akdas-site/blob/main/literature/references.bib). To add a paper, paste its BibTeX entry there (Google Scholar → Cite → BibTeX) and add a short entry below using its key. The same keys work in the manuscript.

## Slab geometry

Models of the top of the subducting slab, for checking the slab recovered by the inversion. @berg2020 (above) also finds the slab beneath southern Alaska deeper than earlier models.

::: {.ak-paper}
**@hayes2018** [To read]{.pill .next} [Paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aat4723){.ak-link}

[Slab2: global slab-geometry model. The Alaska–Aleutians region ("alu") gives gridded slab depth, dip, strike, thickness and uncertainty.]{.why}

[Slab geometry]{.ak-tag} [Model]{.ak-tag}
:::

::: {.ak-paper}
**@hayes2018data** [To read]{.pill .next} [Data ↗](https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/5aa2c535e4b0b1c392ea3ca2){.ak-link}

[The Slab2 grids themselves (USGS data release). Download the Alaska–Aleutians files here.]{.why}

[Slab geometry]{.ak-tag} [Data]{.ak-tag}
:::
